# FG-GIT-0022

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`push-checks`](../../ops/runbooks/push-checks.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_push_with_a_private_key_is_refused_with_fg_git_0022` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: プッシュに秘密情報（鍵やトークン）らしい内容が含まれていたため、プッシュ全体を拒否しました。秘密を履歴から取り除き、漏れた可能性のある秘密は失効させてください。
- en: The push contained what looks like a secret (a key or a token), so the whole push was refused. Remove it from the history and revoke any secret that may have leaked.
- id: Push berisi sesuatu yang tampak seperti rahasia (kunci atau token), sehingga seluruh push ditolak. Hapus dari riwayat dan cabut rahasia yang mungkin bocor.

## 原因 (cause)

The pre-receive hook (M3 X8) found a high-confidence secret pattern in a text blob the push brings: `private_key` (a PEM / OpenSSH / PGP private key header), `aws_access_key_id`, `github_token`, `gitlab_token`, `slack_token`, `google_api_key`, `gitstation_token` (`fgp_` / `gss_`) or `gitstation_webhook_secret` (`whsec_`). Placeholder bodies (few distinct characters, `EXAMPLE`) do not match; a file containing the marker `forge:allow-secret` is a reviewed false positive and is accepted (counted as `allowed`). Blobs above 1 MiB and binary blobs (a NUL in the first 8000 bytes) are not scanned for secrets. git refused the whole push; the quarantined objects are discarded, no ref changed — but the secret has left the pusher's machine.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The pusher sees `remote: FG-GIT-0022 …` with one line per finding: the rule, the path and the commit (never the matched value). One warn log line with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context`: `event=forge.git.push_checked`, `verdict=refused`, `findings`, `rules`, `first_rule`, `first_path`, `first_blob`, `first_commit`, `objects`, `bytes_scanned`, `allowed`, `repo_id` — the value is in no log line.

## 対処 (fix)

Treat the secret as leaked if it was real: revoke / rotate it first (runbook secret-removal, step 1). Then remove it from the unpushed commits (`git commit --amend`, `git rebase -i`, `git filter-repo --replace-text`) and push again. For a synthetic test fixture, add the marker `forge:allow-secret` to the file (a comment line) — the reviewer sees it in the merge request. Runbook push-checks.
